author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

Under the `enableTruth` modifier, the event content keeps the reco products that the truth associators, the truth validators and `DetIdToRecHitMapProducer` read. The list is in one place, `truthContentCompact` in `PhysicsTools/TruthInfo/python/truthEventContent_cff.py`, and `Configuration/EventContent/python/EventContent_cff.py` uses it.

- `FEVTDEBUGHLT` and `RECOSIM` keep the truth products and the offline inputs: the HGCAL rechits, the plain `particleFlowRecHitECAL`, `particleFlowRecHitHBHE`, `particleFlowRecHitHF` and `particleFlowRecHitHO`, `hgcalMergeLayerClusters`, the ECAL and HCAL PF clusters, `generalTracks`, the primary and secondary vertices, and the tracksters of the TICL label registry.
- `FEVTDEBUGHLT` also keeps the HLT inputs (`truthHltInputsKeep`).
- Each keep names the product type, so the other products of the same module are not kept. The offline tracksters are named one by one, because a wildcard keep would also run every unscheduled trackster producer.

For some reason, the standard RECO output keeps only the `Cleaned` instances of the barrel and forward PFRecHits. The `Cleaned` instances hold the hits that failed the PFRecHit quality tests. `DetIdToRecHitMapProducer` reads the plain collections, so on a RECO file it resolves no barrel or forward cell of the truth hit index to a rechit. 

The hit index contents do not change. Its DetIds match the rechit DetIds: at PU200, 99.8% of the ECAL barrel rechit energy and 91% of the HB rechit energy are in index cells.

Cost: only the four plain PFRecHit collections are new in the output. On 20 TTbar events without pileup, compressed, they take HF 2.2 kB, ECAL 1.9 kB, HBHE 1.0 kB and HO 0.2 kB per event. The truth hit index takes 314 kB per event on the same events. Every other product in the list is already kept by the standard content, so the output is otherwise unchanged. The list keeps them under `enableTruth` if the standard content changes.
title: Truth keep calo pfrechits
